stages.name: One-hand dunk
stages.detail: Regulation ball, one hand. The baseline.

stages.name: Two-hand dunk
stages.detail: Both hands on the ball means a lower release point.

stages.name: Reverse
stages.detail: Back to the rim at the finish. Rotation costs a little height.

stages.name: One-hand tomahawk
stages.detail: Ball cocked behind the head, then thrown down.

stages.name: Off the backboard
stages.detail: Self-pass off the glass. Mostly timing once the height is there.

stages.name: Two-hand tomahawk
stages.detail: Both hands behind the head at the peak.

stages.name: Windmill
stages.detail: Full arm circle on the way up. Needs hang time.
Full turn in the air. Takeoff mechanics matter as much as height.

stages.name: Between the legs
stages.detail: Ball under a leg and back up before the rim.

focuses.name: Max touch
focuses.cue: No ball. Full rest between jumps. Every jump is a test.

focuses.name: Approach rhythm
focuses.cue: Start slow, finish fast. Speed builds into the last two steps.

focuses.name: Penultimate step
focuses.cue: Long, low second-to-last step. Hips drop, then explode.

focuses.name: Arm swing
focuses.cue: Arms back on the penultimate, then rip them up through the rim.

focuses.name: Stiff takeoff
focuses.cue: Plant and go. Don't sink into the last step.

focuses.name: Ball control
focuses.cue: Secure the ball on the gather and keep it high through the jump.

focuses.name: Finish at the top
focuses.cue: Release at the peak. Throw it through the rim, not at it.
